question: Which was the first country to host the Asian Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Asian Games:-**

 
 
• **India was the first country to host the Asian Games, in 1951. **
 
• The games were held in New Delhi, and 489 athletes from 11 Asian countries participated in 57 medal events.
 
• Japan topped the medals table with 60 medals, followed by India with 51 medals.
 
• **The Asian Games, also known as the Asiad, is a continental multi-sport event held every four years among athletes from all over Asia. The Games were regulated by the Asian Games Federation (AGF).**
